question: Question
defaultDirections: Select the answer you feel answers the question. When you are done, press {checkAnswer}. You will get feedback indicating correctness of your answer and how to proceed.
relatedContentDescription: This creates a collapsed area for content related to this question and is always shown
hintDescription: This is presented if the user gets the answer wrong
evidenceDescription: This is presented if the user gets the answer correct
selectAllDirections: Select all that apply. When you are done, press {checkAnswer}. You will get feedback indicating correctness of your answer and how to proceed.
